\[
d \approx 2R \arcsin\!\Bigl(\sqrt{\sin^2\!\bigl(\tfrac{\Delta\phi}{2}\bigr)+\cos\phi_1\,\cos\phi_2\,\sin^2\!\bigl(\tfrac{\Delta\lambda}{2}\bigr)}\Bigr)
\]
